title: Server-side DB3 inspection ingest (Desktop stops local open)
description:
Desktop Auto Sync no longer opens WinCan .db3 files on the field PC to push inspection rows. Java still uploads .db3 like any other project file under Shared Base Jobs/… After the file lands, the server downloads it from storage and ingests/compare rows into PipeSync (existing AutoSync PSR ingest).

This removes the noisy “DB3 skipped (not on disk)” / local SQLite open failures while keeping dual WinCan watch folders and full folder upload working.

Who is affected: Desktop Auto Sync users on private server and SaaS after Desktop update + backend deploy. PipeShare browsing of uploaded projects is unchanged; video inspection still uses the cloud .db3.
changeLog: Desktop: local DB3 row open/poll disabled by default (server ingest after upload).
Backend: post-upload hook also fires for single-part PUT via /upload/object-landed (and register-sha256).
Java AutoSync: notifies server after single-part DB3/file PUT; logs “DB3 uploaded — server will ingest…”.
Status UI: DB3 rows show as “Server after upload” instead of a local active path.
